text: {"frames":["Out of the fog came a small voice, counting steps on the bridge over the mill canal. Thijs followed it up the wet stairs and found only a pizza box on the landing, still warm. A note in pencil lay on top: the counter had taken a bite of everything, and whoever wanted the rest had to find the exact half that was left. The pizza had been cut into {a} slices before it vanished. How many slices make half of the pizza?","Please help me, said a small voice from the empty boat that drifted in under the windmill. Anke found a locked casket on the seat and a pizza beside it, cut into {a} slices. The boatman's note said the casket held his lost herring list, and that half of the pizza had to go to the dog who guarded it. How many slices make half of the pizza?","Shh, hummed a voice from behind the cupboard, singing a song Thijs knew only from his grandmother. He pulled the cupboard away and found a pizza on a plate, cut into {a} slices by someone hiding in the wall. The humming stopped when he reached for it, and a scrap of paper slid out from under the plate. Give the singer exactly half, it said, and the tune will come back. How many slices make half of the pizza?","A smell of hot cheese and tomato came down the stairs that were not on the plan. Femke climbed them and reached a floor with a round window and a table laid for a meal. On the table lay a pizza cut into {a} slices, and the chair was pushed back as if someone had just stood up. The chair would take its share, and the rest would wait for whoever came back. How many slices make half of the pizza?","Joop knelt down and lifted the tulips one by one, but they had already moved into rows overnight. In the middle of the field lay a pizza, cut into {a} slices, and the tulips curled round it like the spokes of a wheel. Someone wanted a path through the field, and the path would open only when the pizza was split into two equal heaps. How many slices make half of the pizza?"]}
